`create-code-cli` creates a new code generator CLI project

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`create-code-cli`](/cli/create-code-cli/) | Creates a new code generator CLI project |
| [`create-code-cli install`](/cli/install/) | Installs a Claude skill for CodeGenerator |
| [`create-code-cli scaffold`](/cli/scaffold/) | Scaffold a project from a YAML configuration file |

Every command also accepts the [global options](/cli/global-options/).

## Exit codes

Each command returns one of the documented [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes/). A script can branch on the code without parsing output.
